cardOverview.overviewText: The Union Bank NEXTERIA Credit Card is a super-premium RuPay EKAA metal travel-and-lifestyle card offering unlimited domestic & international airport lounge access, premium hotel and concierge perks, and robust travel-related benefits aimed at affluent users.

benefitRows.name: CLUB ITC
benefitRows.description: 1+1 complimentary buffet at participating ITC Hotels
benefitRows.offer: Get 1+1 complimentary buffet at participating ITC Hotels with your Credit Card.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail the offer, call the 24x7 Concierge at 1800 118 887 or 022 42320226 and share your preferred ITC hotel, date, and time of visit. You will receive a reservation confirmation via email. Present this email at the restaurant during your visit and make the balance payment using your Credit Card. Please refer to the offer details and terms & conditions applicable.

benefitRows.name: CLUB ITC
benefitRows.offer: Book a 3-night stay and pay for only 2 nights at participating ITC Hotels with your Credit Card.|Complimentary night applicable only on room rate; taxes and additional services are payable by the guest.|One complimentary night allowed per booking, valid only for 3-night stays.
benefitRows.howToAvail:
To Avail this offer,
1. Click on Book Now (https://www.itchotels.com/in/en/promotions/hdfc-offer) to reserve your stay.
2. Present the booking confirmation at check-in and pay for the balance room nights using your Credit Card.
3. Please review the offer details and applicable terms & conditions before availing the offer.
4. For cancellations, contact the booked hotel directly via email or their helpdesk number. Cancellations will be accepted as per the individual ITC Hotels’ policies.
